description: Branch protection rules configuration for Witylogix Platform
notes: This configuration file documents branch protection rules.
To apply these rules, either:
1. Configure manually in GitHub repository settings under 'Branch protection rules'
2. Use GitHub CLI: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/{branch}/protection
3. Use Terraform/Infrastructure-as-Code solutions
Required GitHub Actions must pass before merge:
- Lint & Format Check: ESLint + Prettier validation
- Type Check: TypeScript type checking
- Tests & Coverage: Unit tests with coverage reporting
- Build: Turbo monorepo build
- Security Checks: npm audit + license compliance
- CI Summary: Overall pipeline status
Dismiss stale reviews:
- main: YES - Fresh reviews required after new commits
- develop: NO - Allow expedited merges for rapid iteration
Require Code Owner reviews:
- YES for all branches - Ensures domain expertise review
- See CODEOWNERS file for ownership assignments
Require up-to-date before merge:
- YES for all branches - Prevent merging outdated branches
- Prevents CI failures after merge due to conflicts
Allow force pushes/deletions:
- NO for all branches - Maintain commit history integrity
- Only team leads can override via GitHub settings
Require conversation resolution:
- main: YES - All review comments must be resolved
- develop: NO - For faster iteration cycles
- release: YES - Maintain code quality for releases
